biggest_catch: The $200 bonus is FROZEN (held) in your account until the account is 6 months old — you cannot withdraw or use it before then, so this effectively requires a 6-month account relationship.
catches: Requires qualifying direct deposit(s) totaling $700 or more within 45 days of account opening: recurring paycheck, pension, or regular monthly income (incl. Social Security) electronically deposited; personal transfers or branch/online/ATM deposits do NOT qualify.
Also requires enrollment in eStatements AND 15 debit card transactions within 60 days of account opening.
The $200 bonus is held (frozen) in your account until the account is 6 months old and released thereafter.

Not available to existing People First FCU checking members or those whose accounts closed in good standing within 12 months or closed with a negative balance at any time; not available for account conversions.
Limited to one $200 bonus per individual taxpayer identification number.
Offer is limited time and 'subject to change or be withdrawn at any time' — no stated end date.
Membership eligibility required: People First FCU serves select PA/NJ counties (headquartered in Allentown, PA); check peoplefirst.com eligibility before applying.
